messages.subject: MSstats-Shiny User Study
parts:
Hi Everyone,

We are looking for volunteers for a usability study of our newly developed UI interface for MSstats and MSstatsTMT. The study will involve running an example dataset through the platform, answering some simple analysis questions about the data, and filling out a short questionnaire at the end of the study. We anticipate it should take about 15-25 minutes to complete and plan on conducting the trials over the next month. 

We would greatly appreciate it if you could take part in the study and help develop the platform! Please respond to this conversation or email kohl...@northeastern.edu if you would like to participate.

Best,
Devon Kohler
